assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original static Discord sticker for a Puerto Rican and Latin American GTA fan community called VIce District. One centered die-cut cartoon sticker, square composition, transparent background with real alpha. Bold, clean, polished illustration with thick dark-plum outlines and a narrow warm-white outer sticker outline. Color palette: hot pink, plum, electric cyan, coral, warm ivory. Tropical Miami neon mood, cheerful and energetic. Extremely readable at 320x320 pixels. Compact connected silhouette, generous transparent margins, no background scene, no tiny details, no official game logos, no watermark, no extra lettering. Subject: exuberant Puerto Rican celebration badge. Huge chunky lettering reading exactly "¡WEPA!" (inverted exclamation at start, normal exclamation at end), slightly tilted, ivory with hot pink and cyan extruded accents. A small clearly accurate Puerto Rican flag (red/white horizontal stripes, blue triangle and one white star) and one playful neon palm frond behind the lettering, a few large celebratory spark shapes. The lettering is the main subject and fills most of the sticker.
